name: VFX — Muzzle Flash (Destello de Disparo)
generation_strategy: 3 frames individuales 1024×1024 → script ensambla spritesheet horizontal 288×96

frames.role: Peak flash — destello máximo al disparar
frames.prompt: Cartoon game VFX muzzle flash, top-down overhead view, isolated on transparent background, centered. STYLE: vibrant warm cartoon FX matching Brawl Stars quality — bright glowing energy, warm saturated colors, bold punchy shapes. Frame 1 of 3 (peak flash): massive bold cartoon starburst explosion — 6-8 sharp spiky rays radiating outward symmetrically, white-hot glowing core at center, rays transition from bright white to warm golden-yellow (#FFD700) to orange (#FF8800) at tips. The entire shape has a warm radiant glow emanating outward. No hard outlines on light — pure glowing energy. Wide, energetic, exaggerated cartoon punch. The shape must read instantly even at 96x96px. NOT realistic smoke, NOT pixel art, NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic, photorealistic, smoke, subtle, dark, military, pixel art, background, text, watermark, cold colors, gray

frames.prompt: Cartoon game VFX muzzle flash frame 2 of 3, top-down overhead view, isolated on transparent background, centered. STYLE: vibrant warm cartoon FX, Brawl Stars quality. Expanding energy ring: bold circular ring of warm orange-yellow energy (#FF9900), the ring is thick and bright, center is mostly transparent/empty showing the ring has expanded outward. 6-8 small rounded warm orange spark dots scattered beyond the ring edge. The ring glows warmly. Less intense than frame 1 but still bold and punchy. NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic, pixel art, starburst full, dense center, smoke, dark, military, background, text, watermark

frames.role: Residual — último rastro antes de desaparecer
frames.prompt: Cartoon game VFX muzzle flash frame 3 of 3 (final fade), top-down overhead view, isolated on transparent background, centered. STYLE: vibrant warm cartoon FX. Final residual: only 4-6 small glowing warm orange spark dots scattered loosely in a circle, each dot with a tiny warm glow, fading at different opacity levels. A barely perceptible tiny warm amber glow at center. Mostly transparent — the effect is almost gone. Same warm color palette as frames 1-2. NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic, pixel art, bright full burst, smoke, ring, background, text, watermark, dark, cold
